zh: 關鍵字在 SEO 標題
rule: primary focus keyword appears in SEO title (word match)

zh: 關鍵字在 Meta 描述
rule: primary focus keyword appears anywhere in SEO description; KB says keep it in the first 120-160 characters
slugified focus keyword is a substring of the slugified URL
keyword in first 10% of words; whole text when the text has 400 words or fewer
focus keyword appears in content
keyword words inside any <h2>-<h6>
featured image alt or any contains the keyword; a [gallery] shortcode also passes
density = matches of all focus keywords / wp.wordcount words x 100 (2 decimals); <0.5 fail 0; 0.5-<0.75 fair 2; 0.76-<1 good 3; up to 2.5 best 6; >2.5 fail 0
KB recommends 1-1.5% and warns above 2.5%; the plugin still gives full points up to 2.5%
URL length <= 75 characters
at least 1 external link
at least 1 external link without nofollow
at least 1 internal link
focus keyword not used by another post (ajax check; no points)
Content AI used on the post (only applies when Content AI data exists)
keyword starts before the middle character of the SEO title
English locale only: title sentiment score is not 0
a title word equals or starts with a power word from the plugin list
SEO title matches /\d+/ (Arabic digits only)
TOC plugin detected or content contains wp-block-rank-math-toc-block
fails if any paragraph has more than 120 words
images (incl. featured image): 1->1 2->2 3->4 4+->6; videos (YouTube/Vimeo): 1->1 2+->2; capped at 6
round(sum of points / sum of max points of applicable tests x 100)
>80 green; >50 orange; else red
